about: #141: the 8 moves move-gated evolutions need. Built by tools/move_import.js, reviewed in tools/move-review.html. Patterns: tools/move-import-patterns.js. Edits come from the review page; facts fill what pokeapi leaves out of Gen 9 rows.
label: #141 evolution moves

double-hit.note: Two quick swings, as Double Kick (Kanto batch 1: multi-hit moves are quick repeats at full power).

facts.why: pokeapi has no effect data for this Gen 9 move

twin-beam.note: Two quick beams, the beam pattern repeated as Double Kick repeats its swing.

facts.effect: Hits the target even if it is protecting itself (Protect, Detect).
facts.why: pokeapi has no effect data for this Gen 9 move

hyper-drill.note:
Ruled 2026-11-27 (MOVE-INTENT). Heavy swing for now; its hits go through shields once #141 part D builds that.

barb-barrage.note: Ruled 2026-11-27 (MOVE-INTENT). Poison shot, 50% poison; the double power on a poisoned foe comes with #141 part D.

rollout.note:
Ruled 2026-11-27 (MOVE-INTENT). Placeholder plain swing; the ramping power (x1 to x16) comes with #141 part D.

Imported as move similar to Quick Attack or Aerial Ace. Rollout will be used as a movement skill that does damage along its path.

mimic.note:
Ruled 2026-11-27 (MOVE-INTENT). No pattern until #141 part D builds the copy.
